name: Montfort Capital Corp.
summary: Montfort Capital Corp. focuses on acquiring, overseeing, and cultivating businesses that provide private lending solutions to various sectors throughout North America. The company's financial services include offering tailored asset-backed private credit to mid-sized enterprises, as well as supplying revenue-based capital specifically for business-to-business (B2B) Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) firms. Additionally, it provides comprehensive loan administration services. Originally founded in 2007, the entity rebranded from TIMIA Capital Corp. to Montfort Capital Corp. in June 2022, and its main operations are based in Vancouver, Canada.
